reels.title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses 'long-term memory' in AI agents using an efficient storage approach, offering high relevance for the growing field of personal AI assistants. It aligns with the memory/attention category, which has high engagement potential.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI assistant could remember every moment of your year without crashing its brain?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Treating video memories like a library index where you only store the 'highlights' in the front office, while archiving the long, boring footage in a massive basement warehouse.
